stem: For children in the older age range of 5 to 8 years, how long can recovery from transient synovitis take?
explanation: Older children within the diagnostic bracket often require a longer recovery period than younger preschool children.
rationale: Older children in the study group generally have a slightly more prolonged recovery phase.

optionExplanations.A: Older children within the diagnostic bracket often require a longer recovery period than younger preschool children.
optionExplanations.B: Even mild cases generally require at least a week of rest for full recovery.
optionExplanations.C: While this is the standard recovery time for 90% of younger children, the older group may take longer.
optionExplanations.D: This timeline is associated with the observation of X-ray changes in Perthes disease, not the recovery from synovitis.

source.hint: Older children in the study group generally have a slightly more prolonged recovery phase.
